title: Heart of Glass
meaning_summary: Heart of Glass remains commercially useful because it is one of Blondie's clearest catalog anchors for streaming, memory, and rediscovery.
revenue_drivers: Global streaming and broad playlist fit support recurring catalog demand.
High recognition creates repeat listening across generations.
Sync, social reuse, and event-driven spikes can lift the annual baseline.

earnings.assumptions: Estimate keeps the headline range as the artist-side figure and models gross track, label, publishing, and songwriter lanes from that conservative annual range.

ownership.master_owner: Likely controlled through the recording label or distributor unless a specific rights sale is known
ownership.publishing_owner: Writer and publisher splits affect the publishing share shown here
ownership.catalog_sale_status: No specific catalog sale adjustment is modeled for this track
ownership.notes: Heart of Glass is modeled from public-facing catalog behavior and conservative rights-split assumptions, not from audited royalty statements.
